<script>
function toggleFullscreen(btn) {
  const panel = btn.closest('.scroll-panel');

  if (!document.fullscreenElement) {
    panel.requestFullscreen().catch(err => {
      console.error(err);
    });
  } else {
    document.exitFullscreen();
  }
}
</script>
